content.text: The licence provisions meet every element of the preferred position.

input.quote: 13.3 Customer may transfer its licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24. Vendor shall not revoke or suspend a licence except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure.
input.rationale: Section 13 satisfies the preferred position in full. §13.1 grants the subscription access right to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf (plus Authorized Users), so no affiliate/contractor gap exists. §13.2 makes paid-up software and embedded Vendor Technology licences perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free and fully paid for Customer and its Affiliates, with contractor support permitted. §13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor under the broad Customer assignment right in §24.1 (merger, acquisition, sale of assets, no Vendor consent) and limits revocation or suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity, so the grant is not revocable at will or unilaterally suspendable. §24.4 further bars Vendor from suspending or repricing on a Customer change of control. No redline needed.
